verses.verse:
षष्ठांशे तृतीये तु भागें भाग चतुष्पृयम्।
रिषभौ द्वौ च गान्धारौ तत्र स्थाप्याः क्रमेण वै।53।
verses.text: The third sixth [has] four parts; there the two Ṛṣabhas and the two Gāndhāras are to be placed in order.

commentary.text: In the same way, divide the third ṣaṣṭhāṃśa (one-sixth) into four parts and place komal Re, Re, komal Ga, Ga.
